findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Dynamic code execution via getattr/setattr
 * @description Dynamic attribute access could lead to security issues if user input controls attribute names
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/dynamic-attribute-access
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-470
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::builtin("getattr").getACall() or
  call = API::builtin("setattr").getACall() or
  call = API::builtin("delattr").getACall() or
  call = API::builtin("hasattr").getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("builtins").getMember("getattr").getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("builtins").getMember("setattr").getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("builtins").getMember("delattr").getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("builtins").getMember("hasattr").getACall()
select call, "Dynamic attribute access that could be unsafe if attribute names come from untrusted input."
findings.hypothesis: Dynamic attribute access (getattr/setattr) could lead to security issues if user input controls attribute names
